user.description: Please enter the username and password for your LK Systems account
user.title: LK Systems

abort.already_configured: This LK Systems account is already configured. One integration entry covers your whole account, including multiple Cubic Secure devices - you don't need to add it again to see additional devices.

auth_failed.title: LK Systems authentication failed
auth_failed.description: The integration could not log in to your LK Systems account. Go to Settings > Devices & Services, select LK Systems, and follow the reauthentication prompt to re-enter your username and password.

persistent_update_failure.title: LK Systems repeatedly failed to update
persistent_update_failure.description: The integration has failed to fetch data from the LK Systems cloud API several times in a row. Check your internet connection and the LK Systems service status. This clears automatically once an update succeeds.
